description_en: Queries whether Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to obtain information about the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 检查防护包服务的授权状态，即是否授权防护包查询ECS服务器信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp check-grant --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-slr true --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckGrant

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow Anti-DDoS Origin to check the service-linked role. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
防护包授权是否检查SLR角色。取值：

true：表示检查SLR角色。
false：表示不检查SLR角色
parameters.name: is_slr

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to obtain information about the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

1: Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to obtain information about the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

0: Anti-DDoS Origin is not authorized to obtain information about the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account
Status.description_zh:
授权状态。取值：

1：已授权DDoS原生防护获取公网IP资产（例如，ECS、SLB实例等）信息。
0：未授权DDoS原生防护获取公网IP资产（例如，ECS、SLB实例等）信息
